ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3050 OC Edition 6GB GDDR6 Graphics Card

Experience immersion and ray-traced gaming visuals within an efficient footprint with the ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 3050 OC Edition 6GB GDDR6 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by NVIDIA's Ampere architecture featuring 2nd Gen RT Cores and 3rd Gen Tensor Cores for AI-accelerated performance like DLSS, this graphics solution runs with 6GB of GDDR6 memory layout on a 96-bit interface. Engineered perfectly for standard or compact system integration, it operates effectively entirely through slot power without requiring external PCIe power connectors. The thermal shroud houses dual Axial-tech fans with IP5X dust resistance and a quiet 0dB fan stop profile to balance high airflow with silent operation. Factory overclocked out of the box, this highly reliable and energy-efficient GPU layout is backed by a 3-year factory agent warranty.
